items.claim: The KOSPI rose 4.34% to close at 4,915.68 on November 27, 2026, as foreign investors bought a net 1.13 trillion won of local shares.
The Bank of Korea raised its Base Rate by 25 basis points to 3.25% on November 26, 2026, citing stronger growth, above-target inflation and financial stability risks.
Tokyo's core CPI excluding fresh food rose 2.9% from a year earlier in mid-November 2026, up from 2.6% in October, while headline CPI rose 2.8%, according to Japan's Statistics Bureau.
